title: Sheet units are bijective and integral sheet tuples glue
statement: Use the trace data [def-sfb-finite-etale-trace-data]. Let p:V→S be etale, L a rational continuous-coefficient module sheaf, σ a finite splitting of p over U, and h:B→U. Each sheet unit L(B)→(p*L)(B_j) is bijective. For every integral submodule sheaf M of p*L and tuple t_j∈L(B) whose sheet units belong to M(B_j), there exists m∈M(B×_S V) restricting to these units on all sheets. No quasi-compactness, nonempty-fibre, constant-degree, or local-freeness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Composition of weakly etale objects along p is left adjoint to base change and continuous. Its identity coefficient map, together with projection precomposition, satisfies the two ring triangle equations. Uniqueness of left adjoints therefore identifies module pullback with restriction. Evaluate the comparison on the unit and the sheet section to obtain the identity-base restriction isomorphism, proving bijectivity.

Pull σ.coproduct back to B using universal finite coproducts of schemes. The pullback squares have lift c.fst followed by the base projection; the identities follow from pullback uniqueness. This gives the actual sheet inclusions as a coproduct, including an empty family.

The coproduct inclusions are disjoint open immersions and form a pro-etale cover. The sheaf axiom identifies sections with tuples: equal-index overlaps cancel a monomorphism, unequal-index overlaps are empty, and the empty-cover axiom makes sections on an empty object unique. Apply this to the integral submodule sheaf and the given tuple.

theorem finiteEtaleTrace_sheet_lifting
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {V S : Scheme.{u}} (p : V ⟶ S) [Etale p]
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (traceFieldRing l E S))
    {U : S.ProEt} {J : Type u} [Finite J] (σ : TraceImageSplitting p U J)
    {B : S.ProEt} (h : B ⟶ U) :
    (∀ j, Function.Bijective (fun t : L.val.obj (op (AsSmall.up.obj B)) ↦
      traceImageSheetUnit l E p L σ h j t)) ∧
    ∀ (M : ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (traceIntegerToField l E V)).obj
        ((traceModulePullback l E p).obj L)).val.Submodule)
      (_ : Presheaf.IsSheaf (proEtaleModelTopology V) M.toPresheafOfModules.presheaf)
      (t : J → L.val.obj (op (AsSmall.up.obj B))),
      (∀ j, traceImageSheetUnit l E p L σ h j (t j) ∈
        M.obj (op (AsSmall.up.obj (traceImageSheetObject σ h j)))) →
      ∃ m : M.obj (op (AsSmall.up.obj ((proEtaleBaseChange p).obj B))),
        ∀ j, traceImageSheetRestriction σ h j ((traceModulePullback l E p).obj L) m.val =
          traceImageSheetUnit l E p L σ h j (t j)
